description: Cross-platform byte-parity vectors for the Phase-0 MOCK Windows App Check attestation MAC. The C# MockAttestationMac.Sign MUST reproduce every `mac` byte-for-byte, proving parity with the server's signMockAttestation in functions/src/callables/windowsAppCheck.ts.
oracle: Independently generated with openssl (NOT the C# code under test): printf '%s' "$domain|$appId|$nonce|$issuedAtMs|$secret" | openssl dgst -sha256. The identical formula is what the Node server computes and constant-time compares.
